headline: Demand, Project Growth and Product Diversity Boost the Performance of the UAE Real Estate Sector
summary: The UAE real estate sector continued its strong performance in the first half of 2026, supported by investment demand and development activity. Regulatory frameworks also improved the appeal of property markets.
why: Real estate is a major driver of the UAE economy, and property demand and development influence banking, construction and investor flows.
